div.div:
Gaps (not drawn):
• Networking: no VNet, subnets or private endpoints are stated; every service is public (private networking is Deferred in the spine). Which services must move behind private endpoints before real data?
• Secrets: the spine keeps secrets in Container Apps secrets, but Key Vault is Deferred; where will secrets live beyond the POC?
• Environments: only one 'demo' environment; dev/test/prod separation isn't stated.
• Failover region and backups beyond the PostgreSQL Flexible Server defaults are not stated (Deferred).
• No official Azure icon for Microsoft Foundry: the Foundry group uses the AI Studio (former name) stencil, and the hosted agent is a plain box.
• AD-20 places the feedback job in the foundation stack but does not name its Container Apps environment; it is drawn in the only environment the spine has. Is that the one?
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
Arrow colour shows where the arrow goes: every arrow into the same element has that element's colour.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
